I can't give you a dosing amount — that's something only Sol's pediatric team should confirm, because the right dose depends on Sol's weight, not just age.

**Call your pediatrician's after-hours line right now.** A 39.5°C fever in a 6-month-old warrants a call even outside office hours — most clinics have a nurse line for exactly this. They'll give you the correct ml based on Sol's weight and confirm whether Tylenol is the right call.

While you're dialing, have Sol's most recent weight handy if you know it.
